caseNameFull: McConnell, United States Senator v. Federal Election Commission and Federal Election Commission v. McConnell, United States Senator

opinions.text: D. C. D. C. Motions to dispense with printing the District Court’s opinions denied. All appellants are directed to file 40 copies of a single appendix prepared in compliance with this Court’s Rule 33.1 containing the District Court’s opinions, which will serve as an appendix to all jurisdictional statements.
